display_long_description:
Welcome to Paws & Whiskers, the pet shop that's all yours.

CARE FOR YOUR ANIMALS
Stroke kittens until the hearts fly, pick up puppies, wave a feather wand and throw the ball for a game of fetch. Tip food bags into bowls, fill the watering can at the tap and keep every pen clean. Happy pets sell for more.

RUN THE SHOP
Flip the OPEN sign and welcome your customers. Unpack delivery boxes, stock the shelves with food, treats and toys, scan items at the checkout and take card payments. When a customer falls for a pet, hand it over in its carrier and send it off to a loving home.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS
Order animals and supplies on your PawPad tablet, complete daily tasks, open mystery boxes and level up. Unlock the Aquatic Wall, Bird Corner, Reptile Room and Exotic Suite, add upgrades like smart feeders and express delivery, and decorate your shop to bring in more visitors.

30 SPECIES TO COLLECT
Kittens, puppies, bunnies, goldfish, jellyfish, an octopus, parrots, toucans, snakes, tarantulas, a fox kit, a mini pig and two legendary babies: a penguin and a panda. Fill your Pet-dex!

MADE FOR VR
Hands-on interactions everywhere, a guided tutorial with helpful hints, and comfort options including teleport, snap turning and a comfort vignette.
